selection: Only first eight lexicographically sorted IDs of frozen 429; all eight retained including opaque/rejected. No label/rank lookup.
representation: Native restricted Rust syntax tree, NOT Aroma schema; candidates are nearest visible lexical binders, NOT Rust/type/name resolution.

schema_contract.nodes: node_id, syntax_kind, parent_id, ordered_children (source-byte sorted), range half-open UTF8, role, scope_id, coverage=supported|opaque, reason for opaque, subtree_closed (no opaque descendant)
schema_contract.scopes: scope_id,parent_id,kind; function and each block; live frame contains sequential binders and uncertain flag
schema_contract.occurrences: node_id,scope_id,role,spelling,normalized_name,binder_candidate,candidate_status; name roles method_name/field_name/function_name are not local uses
schema_contract.coverage: root subtree_closed only over exported tree; excluded punctuation/trivia not claimed as nodes. Every unsupported subtree opaque with original byte range and reason; type syntax opaque, not semantically visited; never full Rust coverage.

support: ImplItemFn parse; self and PatIdent parameters without subpattern/attributes
sequential simple let; initializer before registering binder; block frames pop; raw-ident prefix normalized for lookup
single segment ExprPath with no qself/leading colon/arguments
call/method (receiver, name, args; method generic arguments opaque)
literal, unlabeled block, paren/group, binary, unary, assign, reference, field, index, tuple, array, return
unsupported_policy: No general visitor fallback: all other expressions opaque named by variant/reason
closure, match, for, if/iflet, async, unsafe, loop, macro, complex patterns/items/let-else all opaque; no partial invented scope semantics
unknown expression/statement effects taint current scope; all uses under any live tainted scope get null+unknown_scope, even known local names; popping frame restores outer certainty
qualified/generic paths and type annotations opaque but do not introduce lexical binders or taint scopes
attributes on statements/expressions conservatively opaque and taint; function/parameter attributes mark function frame uncertain; cfg never evaluated
candidate absence in fully known frames is no_visible_lexical_binder, not unresolved-symbol error; calls may resolve outside local lexical scopes
expected_checks: all nodes exact byte-valid spans, reciprocal parent/children and no cycles; children source ordered; scope references valid
binder visibility as expected_local_uses for listed names, unknowns retained; unresolved external callee names ignored by that assertion only
03 method touch and field field non-local roles, receiver self local;04 raw spelling and multibyte slice exact
06 qualified path opaque;07 closure opaque;08 complex let opaque;09 match/for/if opaque;10 macro/attribute/item opaque;11 uncertainty pops
12 rejected empty nodes and diagnostic, all malformed raw logs preserved
all nodes subtree_closed recursively equals supported and all children closed; no unsupported nodes silently omitted
execution: One initial control batch, at most two narrowly scoped repair batches on same controls; preserve each source and output version. Corpus extraction only after controls pass, once for all eight. Stop on budget exhaustion; no widening syntax to improve coverage.
artifacts: Runner/tests, source snapshots, Cargo/lock snapshots, before/after hashes, build stdout/stderr/exits/environment, control and eight source/output/log hashes; no ranking/LLM/production changes.
